verses.text: For the music director, to the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Have mercy on me, God. People want to swallow me up. They attack and oppress me all day long.
My enemies try to swallow me up all day. So many rise up and fight me in their pride.
When I’m afraid, I put my trust in you.
I praise God for his word. I trust in God and won’t be afraid. What can mere flesh do to me?
All day they twist what I say. Every plan they make is meant to hurt me.
They plot together, hide, and watch every step I take. They’re waiting to take my life.
Will they get away with their wrongdoing? In your anger bring the peoples down, God.
You’ve counted all my wanderings. You keep my tears in your bottle. Haven’t you written them in your book?
When I call out, my enemies will turn back. I know this much: God is for me.
I praise God for his word. I praise the LORD for his word.
I trust God and won’t be afraid. What can anyone do to me?
I owe you the vows I made, God. I’ll bring you offerings of thanks.
You’ve rescued my life from death and kept my feet from falling, so I can walk before God in the light of the living.
